facts.fact: NITA-U's National IT Survey, carried out January to April 2022, found 60.6% of local government administrations had institutional internet access; 95 of 128 sampled districts gave full data, with 17 municipalities and 10 town councils inside them also responding.
facts.system: Institutional Internet access of local government administrations

facts.fact: NITA-U's 2022 survey reports 60.6% of local governments with institutional internet access, 80.5% giving staff internet over institution wireless networks and 26% over institution-owned USB modems; among those connected NITA-U was the provider for 70.1%, Airtel 26% and MTN 14.3%.
facts.system: Institutional Internet access of local government administrations

facts.fact: NITA-U's 2022 survey found local governments used the internet mostly for email (90.9%) and for providing services to the public (74%), least for purchasing (18.2%); 2.5% of local government staff routinely used the internet at work.
facts.system: Institutional Internet access of local government administrations

facts.fact: NITA-U's 2022 survey names NITA-U, the state's IT authority, as the leading internet provider of connected local governments, serving 70.1% of them.
